## About
Blaine's Motor Supply was started by the late Blaine Taylor, who spent his career in the automotive engine business. Today it is still family owned and operated, with the second generation working in the shop every day.
We keep a large inventory of rebuilt engines for foreign and domestic cars and trucks, plus top brand engine parts. Our complete automotive machine shop handles block preps, boring, valve jobs, align hone and balancing. In recent years we have also built IMCA race engines and cylinder heads.
You can find us on Scyene Road in Dallas. Call ahead or stop by during the week or on Saturday.

## Services
- Rebuilt engines: Rebuilt engines for foreign and domestic cars.
- Engine parts: A large stock of top brand engine parts for the job you are working on.
- Connecting rods, camshafts and crankshaft kits: Individual components including connecting rods, new and reground camshafts, and crankshaft kits.
- Complete automotive machine shop: A full machine shop to handle your internal engine needs.
- Block preps, boring and valve jobs: Custom block preps, boring, valve jobs, align hone and balancing.
- IMCA race engines and cylinder heads: Remanufactured IMCA race engines and cylinder heads.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: We are open weekdays and on Saturday. Give us a call before you come by.

Q: Who do you work with?
A: Both professional mechanics and do-it-yourselfers.

Q: How much does machine work cost?
A: Pricing depends on the job, so contact us and we will go over it with you.

Q: How can I reach you?
A: You can contact us by phone, fax, mail, email or through the form on our site.
